confidence_notes: The FX rate is the latest RBA observation found in search (18 Nov 2026). Food and beer prices come from one search of aggregated cost-of-living sites, mainly crowd-sourced MyLifeElsewhere, Traveltables (2023 data) and a 2026 Pacific Prime estimate. Those sources disagree, so the ranges are wide. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I set them from the usual Taiwan relationship to beer: cocktails at about 3 times the beer price, and wine by the glass at about 2.5 times. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no live listings inspected, and they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tainan is a mid-sized southern Taiwan city with lower prices than Taipei. I based it on local cost-of-living aggregates and on typical Taiwan city prices for hostels and hotels.
